dev_agent_struggles.where: Shell conversion — MainPage SplitView + ListBox navigation
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The SplitView pane with ListBox scenario list does not render in WinUI 3, making all 7 scenarios unreachable. The hamburger toggle button exists but clicking it does nothing visible.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 0 — the agent did not detect the issue because the validator and smoke launch only check that the app starts, not that navigation works
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The agent preserved the UWP SplitView + ListBox + RelativePanel shell structure instead of converting to NavigationView + Frame. The SKILL.md shell conversion table says 'MainPage + ListView + Frame → NavigationView + Frame' but the source uses ListBox (not ListView), so the agent treated it as a non-matching pattern and preserved it as-is. The SplitView pane rendering fails in WinUI 3 (likely due to missing referenced assets microsoft-sdk.png/windows-sdk.png in the pane or RelativePanel layout incompatibilities).
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — the agent declared success after the validator passed
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Broaden the shell conversion table in SKILL.md to include ListBox alongside ListView as an SDK-sample idiom pattern. All UWP SDK samples use ListBox (not ListView) for the scenario list.

missing_tooling.need: Validator check for navigation reachability — verify that the scenario list control renders and all scenarios are reachable
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire navigation failure went undetected because the validator only checks that the app starts, not that the navigation surface works
